title: How to use Gemini: A detailed beginner's guide
author: Jessica Lau
content_snippet: Gemini, Google's AI chatbot, offers all the same features you'd expect from any AI chatbot: it can browse the web, conduct in-depth research, analyze and visualize data, generate AI images and videos—you name it, it can do it.   But, for my money, the best thing about Gemini is that it integrates deeply with other Google products.
